<div style="text-align:center"><div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto">

<table style="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;border:0;width:100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">
<tr style="page-break-inside:avoid">
<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top" align="left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#160;5.02</span></td>
<td align="left" style="vertical-align:top"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On October&#160;26, 2020, Peabody Energy Corporation (the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Company</span></span>&#8221;) announced the appointment of Darren R. Yeates as the Company&#8217;s Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer, effective as of November&#160;1, 2020. Mr.&#160;Yeates, age 59, has been a member of the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Board</span></span>&#8221;) since February 2020 and will remain on the Board as a <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-independent</span> director. However, he will step down from his current positions as a member of Audit Committee and the Health, Safety, Security&#160;&amp; Environmental Committee of the Board, and will not thereafter serve on any other committees of the Board. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Prior to this appointment, Mr.&#160;Yeates served as a director and principal of Yeates Advisory Services Pty Ltd, a consulting firm he <span style="white-space:nowrap">co-founded</span> in&#160;November 2016. Mr.&#160;Yeates has over 35 years of mining industry experience, recently serving as COO of MACH Energy Australia, a developer and supplier of thermal coal to both the Australian domestic and Asian export markets, from May 2018 to December 2019. He was previously CEO of GVK Hancock Coal from January 2014&#160;to&#160;June 2016, and prior to that, spent over 22 years with Rio Tinto in multiple positions, including Acting Managing Director and Chief Operating Officer for Coal Australia. Mr.&#160;Yeates has served as a director of WorkPac Pty Ltd, a diversified employment recruiter, since January 2018, and as a director at Emeco Holdings Limited, an Australian mining services company, since April 2017. He also served as a director at Stanmore Coal Limited, an Australian coal company, from May 2019 until February 2020 and recently served as CEO of WorkPac Group. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Mr.&#160;Yeates has a Bachelor of Engineering (Mining) from University of Queensland, a Graduate Diploma in Management from the University of Central Queensland and a Graduate Diploma of Applied Finance and Investment from the Securities Institute of Australia. He has an Executive MBA from the Monash Mt Eliza Business School and is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Employment Agreement </span></p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In connection with Mr.&#160;Yeates&#8217; appointment as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company, Mr.&#160;Yeates entered into a contract of employment, dated October&#160;22, 2020 (the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Employment Agreement</span></span>&#8221;) with Peabody Energy Australia Coal Pty Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company. The material terms of the Employment Agreement are summarized below. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Mr.&#160;Yeates will receive: (i)&#160;an annual base salary of $700,000; (ii) <span style="white-space:nowrap">a&#160;one-time&#160;cash</span> signing bonus in the amount of $600,000 within 30 days of the commencement of his employment, which is subject to repayment in full in the event that Mr.&#160;Yeates voluntarily resigns or is terminated for cause within one year of commencing employment; (iii)&#160;a short-term incentive compensation (&#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">STI</span></span>&#8221;) opportunity with a target level of 100% of his base salary, pursuant to the Peabody Energy Corporation 2017 Incentive Plan (the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Plan</span></span>&#8221;), prorated for fiscal year 2020; and (iv)&#160;a target long-term incentive compensation (&#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">LTI</span></span>&#8221;) opportunity valued at approximately 140% of his base salary, pursuant to the Plan. Mr.&#160;Yeates&#8217; performance-based STI and LTI payouts will be based upon the achievement of the Company&#8217;s performance objectives as approved by the Compensation Committee of the Board. The Employment Agreement requires Mr.&#160;Yeates to relocate to the Company&#8217;s headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri at the earliest opportunity, but not later than April&#160;12, 2022. While Mr.&#160;Yeates has not entered into the Company&#8217;s standard form of participation agreement for executive officers of the Company (a &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Participation Agreement</span></span>&#8221;) under the Peabody Energy Corporation 2019 Executive Severance Plan (the &#8220;<span style="font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Severance Plan</span></span>&#8221;), Mr.&#160;Yeates will be required pursuant to the Employment Agreement to comply with the terms of the Severance Plan and Participation Agreement during his employment and may be entitled to the benefits set forth in the Severance Plan upon certain terminations of his employment, subject to Mr.&#160;Yeates&#8217; satisfaction of the requirements set forth in the Employment Agreement, Severance Plan and Participation Agreement. Finally, as a condition of his employment with the Company, Mr.&#160;Yeates will serve on not more than one <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-Company</span> board, and any new directorships must be approved in advance by the Company&#8217;s President&#160;&amp; CEO. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The foregoing description of the Employment Agreement does not purport to be complete and is subject to, and qualified in its entirety by, the full text of the Employment Agreement, a copy of which is attached as Exhibit 10.1 hereto and incorporated by reference. </p>
</div></div>



<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

 <p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">There are no family relationships, as defined in Item 401 of <span style="white-space:nowrap">Regulation&#160;S-K,&#160;between</span> Mr.&#160;Yeates and any of the Company&#8217;s directors, executive officers, or persons nominated or chosen to become a director or executive officer. There is no arrangement or understanding between Mr.&#160;Yeates and any other person pursuant to which he was appointed as the Company&#8217;s Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. There are no transactions or proposed transactions in which Mr.&#160;Yeates has any direct or indirect material interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of <span style="white-space:nowrap">Regulation&#160;S-K.</span> </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The following documents apply to the offer of employment made by Peabody Energy Australia Coal Pty Ltd
(the <B>Company</B>) to you: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:4pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">(a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; General Conditions document (<B>General
Conditions</B>); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Schedule 1 - Employment Offer Term Sheet (<B>Employment Offer Term
Sheet</B>); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Schedule 2 - Chief Operating Officer Job Description (<B>Job
Description</B>) </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">(d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Schedule 3 - 2019 Executive Severance Plan (including without
limitation the Participation Agreement in Exhibit A) (<B>2019 Executive Severance Plan</B>); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">(collectively referred to as the
<B>Contract</B>) </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Any ambiguity or discrepancy between the documents set out above is to be resolved and interpreted according to
the same order of precedence as the documents are listed, with the documents higher in the list having higher priority. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:10%; margin-right:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">If you
accept the Contract, while you are not formally a participant in the 2019 Executive Severance Plan (the <B>Severance Plan</B>) with Peabody Energy Corporation and have not formally entered into a Participation Agreement pursuant to the Severance
Plan, you acknowledge that you are required to comply with the terms of the Severance Plan and Participation Agreement during your employment with the Company as set out in this Contract, and that you will be entitled to the benefits set forth in
the Severance Plan upon certain terminations of your employment, subject to your satisfaction of the requirements set forth in the Severance Plan and Participation Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:24pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Background checks </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">It is a condition of your employment that you satisfy a number of background checks, which shall be reviewed at the Company&#146;s sole and absolute discretion,
including but not limited to: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:3pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Right to work in Australia </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The commencement and

including the payment of your reasonable costs of lawfully securing and maintaining required approvals. You must provide to the Company and/or the Department of Home Affairs, all relevant documentary evidence that is required by either or both of
them, within the timeframes specified by them. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS </B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Your ongoing employment will be subject to maintaining your health and fitness at a level relevant to your role and work requirements. You may be required to undergo
periodic medical examinations to monitor your fitness for work. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Consent to Drug and Alcohol Testing </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Upon entering into this Contract, a condition of your employment is that you agree and consent to undergo drug, alcohol and substance abuse testing as required by the
Company in accordance with our policies and procedures, as amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Safety </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Company will provide equipment and facilities it considers necessary for you to perform your duties safely. In performing your duties you are required to work in a
manner that will not injure or put at risk yourself, fellow employees or any other person on site. You will be required to attend an induction course prior to commencing work on a site. You are required to wear and use accident prevention equipment
and protective clothing supplied by the Company for the purpose for which it is supplied, at all times whilst on site. Should you be required to drive motor vehicles to execute your duties, you must maintain a current licence appropriate for the
class of vehicle. You must immediately notify your Manager of expiry, restrictions or loss of licence. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>EMPLOYMENT TYPE AND HOURS OF WORK
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You will be employed as a full-time permanent
employee subject to termination of employment in accordance with the terms of this Contract. Your ordinary hours of work will be 38 hours per week plus reasonable additional overtime. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Peabody Energy&#146;s subsidiaries, affiliates and customers span the globe. Peabody Energy&#146;s global headquarters and certain departments and operations with whom
you will regularly interact have time zones that are different from Brisbane, Australia. Circumstances -will routinely require you to work outside normal hours including on weekends and public holidays to ensure the full requirements of your
position are met. Your remuneration package has been developed to account for this and is inclusive of all amounts payable for all hours worked. The Company reserves the right to vary these work arrangements as business requirements dictate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>WORK LOCATION </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Whilst you will be initially based in Brisbane, Australia, this role is a US based position and you are required to spend up to 50% of your time working in St Louis,
Missouri. You and the Company agree that you will seek an essential business exemption to allow you to travel to the US to perform your duties as necessary, and that your ability to meet these requirements is subject to securing that exemption. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Additionally, you may be required to travel as part of your duties and work at places other than Brisbane or St Louis, for short periods of time. Any ad hoc travel, and
associated costs, connected with your employment will be paid for by the Company. You also acknowledge that your workplace may change during the course of your employment at the reasonable direction of the Company. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">

<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>RELOCATION TO UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND SUBSEQUENT EMPLOYMENT </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Requirement to relocate </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You agree that you will relocate to the Company&#146;s headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, USA at the earliest opportunity, but not later than 12&nbsp;April 2022. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Company will provide support and assistance, including legal counsel of the Company&#146;s choice, to obtain the relevant employment authorization and work visa,
along with appropriate visas for an accompanying spouse and for dependent children under the age of 26. Upon relocation to the US, you will become an employee of the US entity. For the avoidance of doubt, your relocation to the US will be a local
assignment and not an expatriate assignment. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You will be provided with relocation benefits in accordance with the Company&#146;s then-applicable relocation
practices. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Termination of Contract and Relocation </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">This Contract will terminate and have no further force or effect at the earlier of your relocation to St Louis, Missouri or 12&nbsp;April 2022. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Upon relocation to the USA, Peabody Investments Corporation (<B>PIC</B>) intends to offer you employment in accordance with applicable law in the USA and subject to the
relevant aspects of the Employment Offer Term Sheet located at Schedule 1 and the 2019 Executive Severance Plan located at Schedule 3 to this Contract. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT
 COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Failure to Relocate </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">If you decide that you will not be relocating to the US, you must provide the Company with 90 days&#146; written
notice prior to 12&nbsp;April 2022. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">If you do not relocate to St Louis, Missouri by 12&nbsp;April 2022, this Contract and your employment will automatically
terminate on that date without a requirement for either party to provide notice to the other. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Notwithstanding any other provision in this Contract, if you fail to
relocate to the US by 12&nbsp;April 2022, you will not be entitled to any termination payments, including under the 2019 Executive Severance Plan upon your termination of employment. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>REMUNERATION AND EXPENSES </B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Your remuneration has been structured to include all factors associated with this appointment, including but not limited to hours of work and other allowances and
conditions and is paid in satisfaction of any entitlements to </P>

normal course of employment and subject to Compensation Committee approval. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Your total remuneration package is reviewed annually at the Company&#146;s
discretion and is subject to approval by the Compensation Committee of the Peabody Energy Corporation (<B>PEC</B>) Board of Directors (the <B>Compensation Committee</B>). If you join the Company between 1&nbsp;October and 31&nbsp;December of the

<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>SUPERANNUATION </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:3pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Company will make monthly contributions (currently at the rate of 9.5% of your Base Annualised Salary) in accordance with legislative requirements up to the maximum
superannuation contribution base. Salary sacrifice options are available to you should you wish to make additional contributions, these will be in accordance with the applicable company policy as amended from time to time and Australian taxation
legislation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>SIGNING BONUS </B></FONT></P>

<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-time</FONT> signing bonus in the amount of US$600,000.00 (less any applicable taxation) within 30 days of you first commencing employment with the Company. The signing bonus will be paid to you in AUD at the
Agreed Conversion Rate. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You agree to repay the full US$600,000.00 (without deduction, and regardless of the currency exchange rate in effect at that time) to the
Company in the event that you resign from your employment or are terminated for cause within one year of commencing employment with the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT

addition to your Base Annualised Salary, you will be entitled to participate in the Peabody short term incentive plan (<B>STIP</B>) and the long-term incentive plan (<B>LTIP</B>). The STIP and LTIP may be changed at the discretion of the Company,
subject to approval by the Compensation Committee. </P>

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">
</DIV><DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; margin-left:3%; width:90%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:hidden;padding-top:3pt">

<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Company will obtain approval of the Company&#146;s shareholder in accordance with the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth)
in the event you become entitled to payments under the 2019 Executive Severance Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>DIRECTORSHIPS &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">At the discretion of the Board, and in
accordance with the PEC Corporate Governance Guidelines, you may be invited to continue your service on the PEC board of directors. While serving as an executive officer and Director, you will not receive any additional remuneration. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You may continue on the WorkPac Board while employed by the Company and we consent to you continuing to hold this position (subject to compliance with PEC policies and
all applicable laws, rules and regulations). You agree to resign from the EMECO board by no later than 31&nbsp;January 2021. Only one <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-Peabody</FONT> Energy Corporation directorship is allowed, and any new
directorships must be approved in advance by the President&nbsp;&amp; CEO. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>COMPANY POLICIES AND PROCEDURES </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Company, its parent company and associated entities have
developed policies and procedures to assist in the effective management of the business. These policies and procedures, including any which are specifically referenced in this Contract, are not intended to be legally binding on the Company and do
not form part of the terms and conditions of this Contract. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The policies or procedures may be modified, replaced or withdrawn at any time. You must familiarise
yourself with all current policies and procedures. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Unless otherwise directed by the Company, you are required to act in conformity with the policies and procedures
in effect at the relevant time. Compliance with the policies and procedures creates no right or entitlement to any benefits or conditions outside the terms and conditions of this Contract. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>CODE OF BUSINESS CONDUCT AND ETHICS </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">The Peabody Code of Business Conduct and Ethics (as amended from
time to time) will be read in conjunction with these conditions of employment and signed in acceptance. Breaches of the Peabody Code of Business Conduct and Ethics will be investigated and subject to findings, disciplinary action up to and including
termination of employment may be taken. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>CONFLICTS OF INTEREST </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Gratuities </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You must not accept from any person or company, any payment or benefit in any form whatsoever, which would constitute a conflict of interest with your employment with
the Company. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You may have Moral Rights in works which you may in the future create in the course of your employment with the
Company. By signing this Contract, you voluntarily and unconditionally consent to all or any acts or omissions by the Company or persons authorised by the Company in relation to any and all works made or to be made by you (whether before or after
this consent is given) during your employment with the Company which would otherwise infringe your Moral Rights. You acknowledge that your consent is given voluntarily and without reliance on any statement or representation made by the Company or
anyone acting on behalf of the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">&#147;Moral Rights&#148; means the right of attribution of authorship, the right to prevent false attribution of
authorship, and the right of integrity of authorship (as defined in the Copyright Act 1968 ( Cth)). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>PRIVACY STATEMENT, IDENTIFICATION AND
SURVEILLANCE </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="line-height:1.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Privacy
Statement </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Certain personal information is collected by the Company about you that is necessary for the Company to effectively manage your employment.
This information may be disclosed to third parties or related companies of the Company where it is directly related to your employment. The information that you provide will not be disclosed to any other organisations or individuals unless required
or authorised by law, or unless you consent to this disclosure. During the course of your employment, photographs of you may be taken and used for advertising / promotional purposes. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Identification </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You consent to the Company
photographing you for identification purpose to help provide a safe and secure working environment for you and others and for Human Resources and other related business purposes. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Surveillance </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">As part of the Company&#146;s duty
of care and as a condition of using the Company&#146;s communication and technology systems, you acknowledge that the Company may conduct the following surveillance: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;continuous and ongoing monitoring, recording and surveillance, from the commencement of your employment, of all
communications and use of information technology systems and electronic resources in the course of your employment and when using resources of the Company outside work; and </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;continuous and ongoing camera (video) surveillance from the commencement of your employment in areas of the workplace
in which you may be recorded. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>LEAVE ENTITLEMENTS AND PUBLIC HOLIDAYS </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:2pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Leave entitlements available to you under this Contract will
satisfy the Company&#146;s obligations under the National Employment Standards (NES), the Fair Work Act 2009 ( Cth) and any other applicable legislation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT
 COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Annual Leave </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Annual leave will be 4 weeks&#146; leave, for each 12 months of continuous service, which will accrue on a pro rata
basis. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">

<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">

<IMG SRC="g98071dsp1b.jpg" ALT="LOGO">

<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </P>
</div>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P>
<DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; width:2%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:hidden;padding-top:3pt">

<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">
</DIV><DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; margin-left:3%; width:90%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:hidden;padding-top:3pt">

<div style="width:97%; margin-top:1.5%; margin-left:1.5%; margin-right:-1.25%">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Annual leave will be paid at your Base Annualised Salary. You may apply for and take annual leave at any time,
provided the leave is taken at a time convenient and approved by your Manager, taking into account Company staffing requirements. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You may be required to take
annual leave, as directed by the Company. It is Company policy that annual leave entitlements should not accrue beyond 8 weeks accumulated entitlement. On termination of employment you will be paid any accrued untaken annual leave entitlements. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You may be entitled, by agreement with the Company, to cash out a portion of your annual leave accrued, provided the cashing out results in the remaining accrual being
4 weeks or more. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Long Service Leave </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Brisbane based employees will accrue long service leave at the rate of 8.6667 weeks for each 10 years of continuous service. Leave is payable at your Base Annualised
Salary and in accordance with applicable state legislation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Personal/Carer&#146;s Leave </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You are entitled to up to 10 days paid leave, calculated according to your work roster, for absences taken for the purpose of Personal leave or Carer&#146;s leave. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman">&#9679;</FONT>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Personal leave refers to leave taken because of an illness or
medical condition; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman">&#9679;</FONT>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Carer&#146;s leave is leave taken to
provide care or support to a member of your immediate family or household due to personal illness or injury or an unexpected emergency. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Personal/Carer&#146;s leave
will be paid at your Base Annualised Salary. You must inform the Company, wherever practicable, prior to the commencement of such absence, of the nature of the illness and the estimated duration of the absence. Company policy will inform you whether
you are required to provide a doctor&#146;s certificate or other supporting documentation. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Personal/Carers leave will accrue on a pro rata basis at the rate of 10
days for each 12 months of continuous service, calculated according to your work roster. Your Personal/Carers leave balance is reduced by any Personal/Carers leave that you take throughout your employment with the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Additional Personal Leave Benefit </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">After the
first 12 months of employment, in the event that you are unable to attend work for reasons of genuine sickness or injury and you do not have accrued but untaken personal leave to cover the full period of the absence, the Company in its absolute
discretion may continue to pay you your salary for a period of up to 6 months from the first day of your absence from work. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:16pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Maintenance of this benefit is entirely
at the discretion of the Company. You are also required to reasonably cooperate with the Company in relation to the management of your rehabilitation, including: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="27">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="27" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="left">Providing up to date information to the Company in relation to the progress of your illness or injury;
</P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P></div><br clear="All">

<p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="left">Your <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">co-operation</FONT> with any reasonable request of the Company in relation to a
graduated return to work on suitable duties. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Compassionate Leave </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">You will be entitled to three days&#146; paid leave payable at your Base Annualised Salary for each occasion when a member of your immediate family or household: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:ARIAL; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="47" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="left">sustains a personal injury that poses a serious threat to their life; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="47" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">c)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL; " ALIGN="left">dies. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT
 COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Jury Service Leave </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">In the event you are required to attend for Jury Service, you will be paid your Base Annualised Salary less the
total of your jury service pay for the first 10 days of your absence. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Parental Leave </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Parental Leave is governed by the Fair Work Act 2009 ( Cth) and the Paid Parental Leave Act 2010 ( Cth), and includes adoption leave, maternity leave and paternity
leave. The Company&#146;s parental leave policy, as amended from time to time, also applies. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:14pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:12pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>Public Holidays </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">Public Holidays as provided for in relevant legislation and gazetted for the coal industry and local government area will be observed, subject to your agreement to work
on these days if reasonably required to fulfil the requirements of your role. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:18pt; font-family:ARIAL"><FONT COLOR="#0065a4"><B>VARIATION TO CONTRACT </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="line-height:3.0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:2pt;border-bottom:1px solid #0065a4">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:2pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:ARIAL">This Contract may only be varied with the agreement of both you
and the Company in writing, subject to the prior approval of the Compensation Committee. </P>

<DESCRIPTION>EX-99.1
<TEXT>
<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>EX-99.1</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">


<IMG SRC="g98071snap-peabodylogo.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:22pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B><I>News Release </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">October&nbsp;26, 2020 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PEABODY NAMES DARREN YEATES AS CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">ST. LOUIS, Oct. 26 &#150; Peabody today announced Darren Yeates has been named Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer effective Nov. 1, 2020.
Darren will have responsibility for all aspects of the company&#146;s operations, including sales and marketing, technical services, health and safety and supply chain. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#147;We welcome Darren&#146;s continued contributions and look forward to the expertise he will bring to this key leadership position,&#148; said Peabody
President and Chief Executive Officer Glenn Kellow. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Darren has been a member of Peabody&#146;s board of directors since February 2020 and will remain on
the board as a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-independent</FONT> director. Darren has over 35 years of mining industry experience, recently serving as COO of MACH Energy Australia, a developer and supplier of thermal coal to both the
Australian domestic and Asian export markets. He was previously CEO of GVK Hancock Coal, and prior to that, spent over 22 years with Rio Tinto in multiple positions, including Acting Managing Director and Chief Operating Officer for Coal Australia.
Darren is a current director of Emeco Holdings Limited, an Australian mining services company, and a former director of Stanmore Coal Limited. In addition, Darren has recently served as CEO of WorkPac Group. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Darren has a Bachelor of Engineering (Mining) from University of Queensland, a Graduate Diploma in Management from the University of Central Queensland and a
Graduate Diploma of Applied Finance and Investment from the Securities Institute of Australia. He has an Executive MBA from the Monash Mt Eliza Business School and is a Fellow of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Peabody (NYSE: BTU) is a leading coal producer, serving customers in more than 25 countries on six continents. We provide essential products to fuel baseload
electricity for emerging and developed countries and create the steel needed to build foundational infrastructure. Our commitment to sustainability underpins our activities today and helps to shape our strategy for the future. For further
information, visit PeabodyEnergy.com. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Contact: </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Julie Gates </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">314.342.4336 </P>
</DIV></Center>

</BODY></HTML>
</TEXT>
